notes.title: War Maiden Mode unleashed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/b0bf694610c4609df34aead6c052c654b4fdb65d.jpg[/img]

(Please note the above contains costumes from both Clea 1 and 2.)

Hey buddy! Hope you are doing good ːcleasunniesː.

As promised, the final, ultimate test of skills has arrived. War Maiden Mode is now available in both Clea 1 and 2. Please note I will be testing the console versions after this, so thank you for your patience, and you can expect the same patch to drop on those platforms soon.

In Clea 1, War Maiden Mode can be unlocked by completing the campaign with the best ending. In Clea 2, War Maiden Mode becomes available once you have conquered Clea's Quest with a silver or higher rank. Survive War Maiden Mode, and the War Gear will be yours. Let it be a proof of your dominance and mastery. The dress contain a cute little ability, which I will leave as a surprise ːexceliaː.

Alongside War Maiden Mode, I have applied a series of tweaks/improvements:

- When you are in an area afflicted with the noise curse, the background ambience will be replaced by chants (for clarity).
- The peek blocking corruption no longer denies you from looking through doors. This felt too unfair.
- Chaos Spiders will now flee, or at least fail to kill you, if they attack right as you are entering a door or closet.
- On Chaos+ difficulty, players will be able to sneak closely behind enemies without being unfairly killed.
- Chaos+ exclusive foes now have slightly different sounding footsteps so you can tell when there are multiple hunters in play.
- Revised the spawn times of some Chaos+ exclusive enemies to improve fairness.
- Minor graphical fixes to some costumes (the candle flames were too solid in a few).
- Fixed bug where on rare occasions, the player character flickers for a frame when a chapter is completed.
- Audio balancing for a lot of sound effects, many of which were too loud. There were also sound effects that would play twice in succession when they were not meant to.

Remember, the Gaia dress has also been added to Clea 1. Complete the campaign with one save or less, and the costume shall be yours. With this third update, there is no better time to re-visit both titles ːwhappyː.

What comes after this? There may well be more Clea related news. We always got work going on, and speaking of which, I should get back to it. Thank you and have fun ːbibiː!

P.S. The Clea 1 and 2 artbooks have been updated with the new costumes, along with artworks tied to the One Year Mission. Hope you like them!

notes.title: War Maiden Mode Survival Guide
notes.content:
Hey bud! Hope you are doing good ːyoyoː.

As mentioned last time, War Maiden Mode is about to drop. The new costumes had been ready for a while now, and War Maiden’s curses had also been programmed earlier for Clea’s Quest. This should have been the easiest update, yet it turned out to be a lot of work. Why is that?

You see, I had to test War Maiden Mode on every difficulty to ensure things did not go out of hand. At first? Things went completely off the rails. Dare I say the mode on Chaos+ was nigh unbeatable. I mean, not even chapter one.

A load of balancing took place, and at last, the mode is ready. Please let me be clear, though. This is still the final, ultimate test. It is by far the toughest challenge Clea players will face. I borderline advise against tackling this on Chaos+ difficulty. There will be deaths, and you will feel frustrated. But, if you are one of the rare few who do survive, I acknowledge you as a true Clea master.

To aid you on your journey, I have compiled some tips in this article. Good luck and have fun. While the mode has been balanced to ensure luck is not needed, it certainly would not hurt.

Now, on with the guide (please note all the screenshots are from Clea 1).

[b]Candle usage:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/d39d91327f31f5c35f2f2e66e69a304d76d984a8.jpg[/img]

I have seen many players in streams hoarding candles. The sentiment is understandable. After all, I too can be a hoarder when I game.

Alas, this is not the time to be saving up. When you feel pressured, it may be time to light that candle. You will be hunted endlessly, so get used to it. Originally, some candles were set to be hidden on Chaos+. I have opted to re-enable them in the next patch, because you will need every last one. This is the tier of madness we speak off.

At the highest skill level, candles can be used to manipulate enemy positions. Each time an enemy flees, they will run to a different area. Let’s say you use a candle, and your hunter runs to the left room, but you would rather he headed right. Well, remember how a candle stays on until you leave the area? You can always run around on the spot, lure the enemy back in, then see if they go right this time. Remember to be patient, and also, please note some foes are coded to roam within specific areas. If you cannot seem to persuade an enemy to run into a certain room, that could be why.

As you may know, unless you are on Light difficulty, or you have ticked infinite saves, each save is going to cost you a candle. It is not in my place to tell you how to play, but in War Maiden Mode on Chaos+, let’s just say there is no shame in playing with infinite saves. On the off chance you actually clear the campaign on Chaos+ with limited saves, you are officially more skilled than the game’s creator.

[b]Chaos management:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/eebe2d48c8fbfd859104fb3a68c640ad55b59ff8.jpg[/img]

War Maiden has a curse that will cause your chaos level to rise, as indicated by the scars on your character. Normally, it would be best to use a potion to heal up right away. In War Maiden Mode, you may wish to hold off. After all, if you have to venture back into the same room, you receive the curse again. Or, perhaps the next room you visit will have that curse instead. Still, no sense in holding out forever, so spend wisely.

What do the scars actually do? In Clea 1, Clea’s chaotic face will at times appear. In Clea 2, War Maiden may appear to stalk (but never kill) you. The effect is the same in both cases. When the curse triggers, enemies within the area will be alerted. Not exactly ideal when you are knee deep in War Maiden Mode.

Still, remember the curse timer resets each time you enter a room. This has two implications:

1. You can exit an area, then go back in, to reset the timer.
2. If you have already been in an area for a while, and you dread a curse may be coming, you may prefer to hide in a closet and wait for it to pass first.

[b]Enemy control:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/3b183d78cbfb74a9e89fbc5955815b1e98a6e8c2.jpg[/img]

In War Maiden Mode, it is not enough to only know a foe has entered the adjacent area. Through audio cues, players must develop a telepathic sense of each enemy’s precise location. This guy is on the bottom floor, and that one is in the middle room. Okay, that means I have 10 seconds to go in here, grab this, and run out. This is the skill level we have now reached.

Also remember, there is no need to wait for an enemy to go a certain way. If they disobey, make them head where you want. Run to produce noise and attract your hunters. Use those sound makers (like the bathrooms). Employ balanced aggression.

[b]Map knowledge:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/5700ac53b138b0998f358188ec1076f5bb4ef591.jpg[/img]

Before you think about tackling War Maiden Mode, you may be wise to learn those maps back to front. In Clea 1, know the Whitlock Mansion like your own house. In Clea 2, every realm must become your second home. Each time you travel to another area, there is a chance a new curse will be afflicted. So, think twice before you enter a room. Maybe this area has items you can do without, or nothing at all. Tread with care.

Speaking of map control and movement, no sense in hiding the trick now. Yes, I am talking about the door swap move (the Logsync Swap) where you switch rooms at the same time as your hunter to evade them. For the sake of immersion, I advise against using this trick (unless you are speed running). Even War Maiden Mode has been designed to be beatable without this exploit. That said, War Maiden Mode on Chaos+? If you resort to this trick a time or two, no one will judge.

[b]Final words:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/d857ac84e2f5154b0b1b63486fec47fbe2a7b879.jpg[/img]

To finish up, please let me reiterate. Yes, I have tested War Maiden Mode on Chaos+ to ensure it is beatable. Still, think twice before going in, because it will be hell and beyond. You know about the Master Levels in Doom Eternal? Recently, I had to train for about a month, running the map Taras Nabad over and over, before I was able to beat it on Ultra Nightmare. This is the level of dedication required to keep War Maiden at bay.

Hm? War Maiden Mode on Chaos+ with invisible foes? Okay, let’s not get too crazy.

See you soon, pal. War Maiden Mode is coming ːwhappyː.

notes.title: Phase 2 preview + release date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/632df056f2c27db8503bf68cb9dee8c1afd2e826.jpg[/img]

Hey bud! Hope you are doing awesome ːcleahappyː.

We are well past the half year mark. 2021 will end before we know it, so the One Year Mission clock continues to tick. Will we succeed? Thankfully, the phase 2 update is on the horizon. Let’s take a peek today, shall we?

First, we have a cosmetic change. In Clea’s Quest, many players took a while before they realized the Chaos Cleanser hints at where the next Chaos Crystal is located. You can look at the symbol inside for a clue, but this can be easy to miss. To remedy this in the next update:

- The symbols now glow more brightly, and in more distinct colors.
- The entire Chaos Cleanser will change colors to match the next realm’s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/75787146be817423256da22f5cb3b5d9a13f868e.jpg[/img]

Next, the final sequence of the main campaign has been updated. Throughout the chapter, you will take brief trips back to previous realms you had visited. The twist is, these realms will be afflicted with War Maiden’s curses.

Please note, these new areas will only increase the final chapter’s length by several minutes at most. The goal is not to pad out the content. Instead, the aim is to introduce players to War Maiden’s curses. This will prepare them for Clea’s Quest and War Maiden Mode, which will be added in phase 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/0afa2f4e6edce9613dc280ddf8567520e34ae35b.jpg[/img]
(Blurred to avoid spoilers)

Let’s finish up with one more item. You see, the theme of phase 2, and this One Year Mission as a whole, is “challenge”. We had Clea’s Quest, and we will end things with War Maiden Mode. These are answers to the top tier Clea players who destroyed the campaign with ease on launch day, and they demand to be tested. With phase 2, I have included a new challenge for you Clea masters.

If you complete the main campaign with one save or less, you will earn a new dress, simply known as “Gaia”:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/d2ac37ad5066c1cd6e0fcc4adae7adf6c030adf6.jpg[/img]

I had considered making the rule “with no saves”, but I have granted you a small act of mercy! It is up to you, of course. By all means, earn it with a no save, no 1-Ups run. Do it on Chaos, or even Chaos+. When players unlock this dress, I want them to feel accomplished. How you achieve that is your freedom.

The phase 2 update will drop on Steam on August 12th. Please note on other platforms, I aim to combine phases 2 and 3, then release them in a single update. Phase 3 should be completed within the next month or two. Thank you for your patience, and please look forward to it.

Thank you ːcleasunniesː!

notes.title: Clea's Quest launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/300ab1ad60433c7e2d6664b037b8e67ffb448896.jpg[/img]

Why hello there ːexceliaː. As promised, a Clea 2 patch has just dropped, with Clea's Quest now available as an unlockable bonus mode! Guide Clea in this replayable challenge as she purges chaos from the Whitlock Mansion. Clea's Quest can be unlocked by clearing the main campaign with the "sacrifice" ending, and if you complete this quest with the best possible conclusion, you will be rewarded with a brand new dress for Florine. Good luck have fun!

By the way, for you completionists, there is a new achievement associated with Clea's Quest. Please restart Steam if needed to trigger the update, then assert your dominance once more ːweedyː.

This patch also comes with a couple of improvements:
- Costume abilities are now shown when you pick your outfit. Hidden on Arcade Mode, because costume powers are disabled there.
- If an enemy catches you while the screen is fading out (from a chapter being completed), it will no longer take away a 1-Up (since that would be unfair). Just like before, you also cannot be killed.
- On Invisible Mode, some enemies could not be seen even during cutscenes. This should no longer be the case.

Console players, please remember the Clea's Quest update will come at a later time. I will be running regression tests over the weekend to give everyone the best possible experience. Please look forward to it ːyoyoː.

Since Clea's Quest has just launched, if you have any feedback, bug reports etc, please shoot them my way via the comments, or wherever else you see fit. As mentioned, Clea's Quest was always planned to be a bonus mode, not an expansion pack or anything of that quantity. Still, if budget allows, let's see what we can do.

It makes me so happy when a game I love receives updates post launch. Balance changes, new maps, modes etc. Business wise, can you do that forever? No. How about supporting a title post launch for around a year? That to me sounds healthy. This is only possible when your support justifies the effort, so thank you, this is for you. Please enjoy Clea's Quest, then after that, there is more work to be done. More fun to be had ːcleasunniesː.

See you again soon ːwhappyː!

notes.title: Clea's Quest preview + release date
notes.content:
Hi there! Are ya winning ːcleasunniesː?

You have seen the Eight Curses of War Maiden; debuffs that will be present throughout these One Year Mission updates. Now, Clea's Quest is ready to drop, so let's take a peek today, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/001f6840fc89fadab29bc5cbe69d3ddff303896e.jpg[/img]

The Whitlock Mansion is filled with negative memories. Grief, anger, regret; feelings that allow chaos to brew. Clea, under the guidance of her new arcane teachers, have returned to purge this chaotic energy.

Her task will not be easy. On a distant land, rumors spread of a family who has opened a portal into the Fourth Dimension. As a result, there is now a rift in the Third Realm. In places where mana is ever present, a person may experience dimensional splits. You may step through a door only to find yourself in a different realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/1408abd53d9dc759eec5fd6b0bac10b60f5adcab.jpg[/img]

Clea's mission is enter the Whitlock Mansion, seek out the Chaos Crystals and expell the dark energy from them. As she does so, the clock tower in which she once lived will no doubt grow more dangerous. In time, War Maiden's curses shall claim the area. Once Clea determines it is too risky to continue, she has been instructed to escape.

What does this mean in gameplay terms? In Clea's Quest, the player's goal is to find the Chaos Crystal hidden within the clock tower. The Chaos Cleanser, given by the Arcane Servants, will hint at the crystal's location. Once you cleanse a crystal, it is on to the next one, and so forth. As you progress, War Maiden's curses will seep in. Once you decide it is time to flee, you will earn one of several endings depending on the number of crystals you have purged.

On a cool note, you can continue to obtain crystals past the best ending. That means the mode can be played over and over, as you can challenge yourself to beat your best record.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/fa1346b82b143e702e3b7fb48d4885a8527679cc.jpg[/img]

If you obtain the best ending in Clea's Quest, you will be rewarded with a new costume, the Blessed Dress, for Florine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/eabfd8ef3136b094655f0cc78a9688832f84c003.jpg[/img]

This dress is purely for cosmetics. It does not come with any abilities, but speaking of which, in the upcoming patch, costume powers will be listed as you pick your dress. What took so long? The truth is, I had never planned to create so many costumes for Clea 1 or 2. It is because of your support that I felt motivated to give back, so thank you!

Some other points to set expectations right:

- Clea's Quest is designed to be replayable (beat your best record, plus random curses on each run), but ultimately, it is a bonus mode. This is not an expansion pack, nor a full blown story continuation (like the Shadow Broker DLC from Mass Effect 2).
- Clea's Quest takes place in the clock tower from Clea 1, with brief trips to other dimensions throughout. For those not looking to challenge their best records, it can be completed quickly in one sitting (depending on your skill level, and the ending you wish to pursue).
- Clea's Quest is gameplay focused (with the replayability factor). I am thankful players have been so keen on Clea's lore, diving into deep discussions on our discord. For further lore/stories, that will take place in a future title, which is in the plans.

Speaking of our friendly discord, please feel free to join us at:

https://discord.gg/Z2yP6fkqCr

Clea's Quest will drop via a Steam update on July 11th (Aussie time, so late on July 10th in the US). The update will be available on PC first. Then, once builds are approved, the same update will go live on the Nintendo Switch and Xbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/a14d20fecbf8ec15ee4c20ffb2adecad1686b698.jpg[/img]

Once the patch is up, Clea's Quest can be unlocked by completing the "sacrifice" ending in the main campaign. If you have already obtained this ending, as soon as the update goes live, you will be able to access this new mode.

Thank you, and good luck have fun!

notes.title: Clea 2 - One Year Mission
notes.content:
Why hello there! Hope you are doing cool ːwhappyː.

[h2][b]Intro:[/b][/h2]

Thanks to your support throughout Clea 1, I had the motivation needed to keep that game fresh. Chaos+, invisible mode, camera feature, the new costumes; these offerings came in the months after Clea's release. In truth, during Clea's development, those ideas never even occurred to me.

See, when you are knee deep in development, especially during crunch, your mind will have no capacity for anything extra. Fix the bugs. Get the features done. Test thoroughly. That certainly was the case during those final few months before Clea 2's launch.

I will always remember this; exactly 11 minutes before Clea 2 was released on the Xbox, I was in the office at my day job. Suddenly, a flood of ideas came. Wait, I can do this! Oh, what if we added that? Because things had winded down, I had the brain space needed for new ideas. I think they had been there all along, because they poured in without conscious thought. They were waiting at the door for space to free up.

On a related note, I still recall how excited I was to finally be able to play Doom Eternal. Got the helmet and everything. After being completely spoiled, spending hundreds upon hundreds of hours in the game, I was pampered further with the two DLC releases. Some of the best fun I ever had.

To sum up, we live in an awesome time where post launch content is a possibility. This sounds like a nice pattern to me; release a game, then spend a year or so supporting it, offering new content. Bring as much joy to players as possible, then onto the next.

With the above in mind, I present to you Clea 2 - One Year Mission:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/99fdd2b4ca92a0aaf9ec5f2a96beff0a6b269e5d.jpg[/img]

Throughout 2021, we will endeavour to develop the following updates. First, please let me reserve the right to alter plans! But, for now, if you have purchased Clea 2, these will be yours. No DLCs. When they are ready, download the update, and enjoy ːcleahappyː.

Oh, please note the below contain spoilers. By all means, play through Florine's campaign first, then come back for these juicy details.

And now, here are the scheduled updates, in order of (planned) appearance:

[h2][b]Mission 1 - Clea's Quest[/b][/h2]

Yes, I have read the reviews, seen the comments. You were happy to see Clea return in the sequel, but you wanted more? Very well. Your wish shall be granted.

As I have mentioned, there are no plans for a Clea 3 right now. That means this quest will truly be Clea's send off. Let's offer her our best wishes as she embarks on this final mission. Make sure your skills are brushed up. This is post launch content, after all. Players can expect a tough yet fair challenge.

For clarity, as you know, this and the below are content updates, not full on DLCs or expansion packs. Please set your expectations accordingly. Outside of that, prepare to have yet more fun.

[h2][b]Mission 2 - Chaos Enhanced[/b][/h2]

Even though I had already provided a spoiler warning, I still want to keep this one a secret. It is not necessarily a new mode, to be clear. Details will be revealed closer to the date. Please stay tuned, and get ready for a hell of a time.

[h2][b]Mission 3 - War Maiden Mode[/b][/h2]

I read a few comments asking for a War Maiden Mode? What a coincidence, as I had the exact same idea in mind. I am happy players are destroying the campaign on chaos+, some on invisible mode, my goodness. At the same time, you monsters need to meet your match.

War Maiden Mode will be a layer that can be wrapped around the campaign. It can be played from light to chaos+ mode. Invisibility on or off. Whatever combination you like. Okay, but what actually happens on War Maiden Mode? Guess you will have to find out for yourself. The ruthless level will be on a tier beyond chaos+. Ready your minds and souls ːcleachaosː.

Please note the above are subject to change until they have been released. Touch wood, but let's say if I release this article, then for some reason, every single one of my games stop selling. At the same time, I lose my job. In that case, of course the above fly out the window. Let's think positive, though.

Thank you friend! And now, I am off to work. Content, after all, comes from grind, not magic ːyoyoː.

notes.title: Post launch upgrade!
notes.content:
Hi there ːcleahappyː! Hope you are doing well. Thank you for your love and support throughout Clea 2's launch week. As you might have seen, Clea 1 just received a major upgrade, which includes three new costumes:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/981020/view/3007816130309491406

Not long after the patch went live, something occurred to me. Wait, that means Clea 2 has less costumes to offer! I will not stand for that, so it was time to return to the lab.

And now, here we are, the first post launch week upgrade for Clea 2, with three new costumes available by default:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/1a2fb848656f1ce9b3abec2036b57f46f9101e70.jpg[/img]

Origin: Check out that purple palette. If you have played Clea 1, you already know what it is ːcleachaosː.

Autumn: Formerly a costume mod, now upgraded to become an official dress.

Snow: A dress inspired by snow and winter!

[b]Additional changes:[/b]

- Reduced the volume of several "switch fail" sound effects so players will not be misled into thinking enemies have been alerted.
- Removed some candles from Chaos+ mode, the same way as things are structured in Clea 1. Good luck!
- Fixed the lighting in some areas and cutscenes where the light would be too bright.
- Increased likelihood of Mei's cat spawning during the prologue (by 5% or more based on difficulty).

Just like with Clea 1's update, I will soon run regression tests for the console versions. Once those pass, I can then submit the same builds up to those platforms. As always, please give the new version a look and let me know if anything comes up. I am available over the next few days.

Thank you! More to come, so please keep it touch ːcleasunniesː.

notes.title: Day one patch
notes.content:
- Fixed a typo ("our" instead of "out").
- Fixed two translation errors. Thank you to our players for raising them!
- Fixed an extremely rare bug where, if you attempt certain movements in the 5 milliseconds it takes to cancel a peek left/right, the camera can get stuck. This was super hard to replicate, but a failsafe has been added, and I have not been able to recreate the issue since.

Thank you!

notes.title: Clea 2 November update (1 Ups feature)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/273dde497239ec31b890e8114b1e52ccea55c3bc.jpg[/img]

Hey gang! A super hot day here in Australia. Just the way I like it. Being sweaty reminds me of my days spent on the basketball courts. It fires me up to put in that work. I have even thought about moving to Singapore, in fact ːcleasunniesː.

Anyway, a new version of Clea 2's demo is out! I have also pushed an update for Clea 1 yesterday. This Clea 2 patch features the same changes. Here are the patch notes:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/981020/announcements/detail/2923360954119998193

There is one other Clea 2 exclusive update. See, when you are killed in Clea 2, sometimes, your hunter will offer some final words. A few players asked for these to be translated, and so, it has been done! In Clea 2's demo, when Mei catches you, her words will briefly appear on screen before your tombstone appears.

Okay! I am off to spend more time riding off cliffs in Lonely Mountain Downhill, followed by more Ancient Gods I Ultra Nightmare training.

Thank you ːcleahappyː!

notes.title: Clea 2 October update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/be0a0a21886d43a1498f09a147e197bcfd2a31a8.jpg[/img]

Hey gang! How are you all going? Hope you enjoyed the Steam Autumn Festival. I for one added some new games to my wishlist. Also, I finished Doom Eternal on Ultra Nightmare over the weekend! Felt so good after hours of training. Still feeling like a champ ːcleasunniesː.

[b]Bonus costume:[/b]

In case you missed it, here is a bonus autumn costume for Florine:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38716872/f8e2c62ba4ebcc0855a77fd72eb0a2a89441a553.jpg[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2250231306]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2250231306[/url]

Hopefully one of several more to come!

[b]Patch:[/b]

Also, an update just went up for Clea 2's demo. Some fixes:

- When an enemy is in a room with a painting while you are in a different one, sometimes, the orbs system will break. You cannot drop an orb, pick up an orb, or the wrong orb is displayed. Hard to catch because of the timing required. So glad I spotted and fixed it yesterday.

- When you and an enemy move into the same area at the same time, your character will spawn far too close to the back wall. Again, a hard to catch timing bug. Thankfully, no more! For your interest, this came up only in Clea 2, because with the sequel, I had to revise the code to cater for some of the new complexities. Hope you will love the hell out of what awaits in the full game.

[b]Chaos/Chaos+ changes:[/b]

Okay, now for something more fun. Have you finished Clea 2's demo? Snuck by Mei to activate that portal? How about Chaos Mode, or even Chaos+? Oh, you have? If so, you may want to try again. In Chaos and Chaos+, you may find a new, unpleasant surprise has been added ːcleachaosː.

Just like with Clea 1, in this sequel, depending on which difficulty you choose, I want to provide more than just faster enemies. Especially on Chaos and Chaos+, there should be re-shuffles, brand new surprises. Keep those adventures exciting throughout the game's lifespan. Full confession, though. This time, it is harder. See, the enemies and maps have increased in complexity. When I add just a touch more, it becomes "too much". Even to me as the creator, it feels unfair. Fortunately, a solution came up during my recent commute, so I will be making some fun tweaks over the coming days. Clea is a horror series, yet it should also be fun. Damn fun.

Best of all, I have more updates planned, so please look forward to them. This demo build is an early access of sorts. You can see Clea 2 evolve along in these coming months.

Thank you friends ːcleahappyː!
